info.title: Andromeda Decision Support API
info.description: Strict source-backed contracts for discovering, comparing and choosing educational programmes across supported universities.

get.description: Compatibility read path for clients that have not migrated to /proftest/sessions. The canonical user flow is the version-pinned session API.

post.description: Compatibility adapter over the existing profile/ranking services. New clients must use /proftest/sessions.
Compatibility adapter that delegates to the canonical profile builder and recommendation service. New clients must complete /proftest/sessions.

ActivityCode.title: ActivityCode
ActivityCode.description: Activity dimensions used by deterministic profile matching.

AdmissionFitMetric.title: AdmissionFitMetric
AdmissionFitMetric.description: One explainable percentage component of the final score.

AdmissionFitReason.title: AdmissionFitReason
AdmissionFitReason.description: A user-facing explanation backed by one or more admission facts.

AdmissionFitResult.title: AdmissionFitResult
AdmissionFitResult.description: Admission Fit result; deliberately independent from Content Fit.

ApplicantAdmissionProfile.title: ApplicantAdmissionProfile
ApplicantAdmissionProfile.description: Subject scores used only by Admission Fit, not by Content Fit.

ApplicantSubjectScore.title: ApplicantSubjectScore
ApplicantSubjectScore.description: One applicant score; the original subject spelling is intentionally kept.

BatchAdmissionFitOutcome.title: BatchAdmissionFitOutcome
BatchAdmissionFitOutcome.description: One source-backed or explicitly unavailable batch result.

BatchAdmissionFitRequest.title: BatchAdmissionFitRequest
BatchAdmissionFitRequest.description: Admission Fit facts for a bounded set of candidate programs.

BatchAdmissionFitResult.title: BatchAdmissionFitResult
BatchAdmissionFitResult.description: Deterministic per-program Admission Fit outcomes, never a global score.

CampusPointType.title: CampusPointType
CampusPointType.description: Stable semantic categories understood by external campus consumers.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.default: Официальный источник не содержит это поле в текущем срезе.

impact.title: Impact
impact.default: Сравнение продолжается, но этот блок нельзя считать полным.

suggestedAction.title: Suggestedaction
suggestedAction.default: Откройте официальный источник и проверьте обновление данных.

DecisionAnalyticsClientEventType.title: DecisionAnalyticsClientEventType
DecisionAnalyticsClientEventType.description:
Events that an HTTP client may report directly.

Mutation facts are server-authoritative and therefore intentionally absent
from this enum.  The subset still covers view and interaction checkpoints.

DecisionAnalyticsPayloadRequest.title: DecisionAnalyticsPayloadRequest
DecisionAnalyticsPayloadRequest.description: Camel-case HTTP adapter for the bounded analytics payload.

PersonalRouteStepKind.title: PersonalRouteStepKind
PersonalRouteStepKind.description: Logical actions; these values intentionally do not describe movement.

ProjectionMetric.title: ProjectionMetric
ProjectionMetric.description: One explainable metric observation; absent data remains absent.

ShortlistRole.title: ShortlistRole
ShortlistRole.description: Explicit role assigned by the user to an active shortlist entry.

SourceGapReference.title: SourceGapReference
SourceGapReference.description: Safe field-level gap exposed to application consumers.
